controls: Four fresh isolated reader contexts; no conversation, findings, implementation notes, or earlier attempt output shared.
Same selected reader model/version, reasoning setting, tool availability and dependencies for every attempt; record exact settings before execution.
Identical task requirements and zero authored application JS/TS across conditions; only installed documentation/helper artifacts differ.
Condition artifact and starter/evaluator hashes recorded before execution.
Do not reveal evaluator assertions or architectural rubric to the reader beyond the neutral prompt and interfaces.
Wall-clock budget begins with task delivery; enforce 600 seconds without implicit extensions.
No retry, recovery attempt or model switch. Preserve timed-out/partial work and errors.
No model reader trials until expressly authorized.
Evaluate behavioral outcomes with the same black-box checks and inspect public submitted code for ownership/cancellation choices.

Report all four outcomes individually, tool/read count, elapsed time, timeout status, completed outcomes, and architecture findings. Do not infer general superiority from two tasks/one attempt per cell.
counterbalancing: Baseline precedes candidate for local editor; candidate precedes baseline for retained dashboard. Each condition appears once in each half of the sequence.
retrievalProtocol: After artifacts are frozen, run each of the 12 reserved questions exactly once per condition. Save raw responses before scoring. Never tune using these queries after observing the held-out result.
